name: Divine Void
summary: A deliberate void: near-black space pierced by one warm gold light, rising dust and embers, weightless drift, Roman-capital captions with one or two words in gold; bright bone-white frames carry crystalline bokeh instead; hard cuts on the beat and one divine flash on a hit.

palette.use: the void: the ground of every dark frame; type colour in bright frames
bone white: captions in dark frames; the ground of bright frames
molten gold: the one warm light of a dark frame; one or two caption words; the bloom's outer colour
ember orange: where gold ramps to at the edge of a light, rising embers
the centre of the divine flash and of a bloom
one glowing red on monochrome, for one or two shock cuts in a whole video

type.emphasis: one or two words in the accent (gold in dark frames)

banned: more than one accent per shot: gold in dark frames, iridescence in bright frames, never both in one shot
red more than once or twice in a whole video
crossfades or dissolves in tempo sections (verse, drop); a shot held past its musical phrase
grey, lifted blacks: the void stays near-black
type that keeps moving once it has landed (the world drifts, the words don't)
readable UI chrome, status bars or captions copied from references; mixed aspect ratios
busy frames: one light, one hero, the rest void
lowercase captions or a second display face

sources.what: ECC's taste skill: "The Mood System" (angelcore × cloud-trance, hyperpop accent), "Editing Grammar", "Beat Math", the shot plan and prompt presets
